summary: Frontend-only verification of new clickable Dashboard hero -> calendar feature. All acceptance criteria pass: hero tap opens calendar modal, selecting Yesterday/Today/Tomorrow/arbitrary day updates hero label ('TODAY'S SALES' vs 'SALES · DD MMM YYYY'), dashboard-today-sales/quantity reflect the selected day (₹0/0 kg when no sales), 'Back to today' reset works, and existing dashboard-date field still opens the same calendar. Regression: creating a sale for today (Ravi, qty 5, price 40, received 200) yielded dashboard-today-sales = ₹200 for today and ₹0 when Yesterday selected, then ₹200 after reset. No uncaught JS errors; only benign RN-Web deprecation warnings (props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver).
critical_code_review_comments: DateField.tsx: The Button label='Today' inside the modal is used both to select today's date and (implicitly) to close on same-day; consider disabling when already selected. Not blocking.

index.tsx: 'dashboard-hero-press' wraps Card in a Pressable which also nests the pending/owe pressables outside — layout is correct, but the hero card's inner 'Change date' pill is decorative only; that's fine but ensure users on mobile understand full-card is tappable (currently hinted by pill). Minor UX only.
seed_data_creation: Playwright ran in isolated browser context; created a sale (Ravi, 5kg @ ₹40, received ₹200) for regression; not persisted across sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature (clickable hero -> calendar) is fully working. When using Playwright, note RN-Web renders Button as a Pressable/div, so page.get_by_role('button', name='Yesterday') does NOT match — use page.get_by_text('Yesterday', exact=True). Modal calendar dismisses on selection. Data-testids on Home: dashboard-hero-press, dashboard-hero, dashboard-today-sales, dashboard-today-quantity, dashboard-date, dashboard-reset-today.
